news.headline: Phil the Godwit Flies 6,800 Miles and Back
news.body: A bird called a bar-tailed godwit named Phil wore a tiny solar-powered tracker. It showed he flew about 6,800 miles to the Arctic and then home to England! Scientists can now find out which wetlands birds like Phil need for food and rest.

news.headline: Meet the Fruit-Loving 'Hell Chicken' Dinosaur
news.body: Scientists have found a new dinosaur called Infernogallus jamesi. Its nickname is the 'hell chicken', but it looks like it liked munching fruit, because its jaws were built for chewing it.

fun_fact: A sea otter holds hands with another otter while sleeping so they do not drift apart! 🦦
